title: Finvasia Shoonya Token Refresh Failures
summary: Multiple automated token renewals returning 401 Unauthorized from Finvasia endpoint. Auto-orders on Shoonya accounts temporarily paused.

timeline.note: Elevated 401 error rate detected by prometheus alert.
Finvasia adapter temporarily paused by Admin to protect trade integrity.
Escalated to Finvasia API support team. Awaiting vendor response.

title: Market Data Latency Spike on BSE Bankex Expiry
summary: Temporary WebSocket queue congestion during market opening bell. Buffer enlarged and Redis stream consumers scaled up.

timeline.note: Latency spiked from 12ms to 480ms on opening ticks.
Spawned 4 additional Redis stream consumer worker pods.
Latency normalized to 14ms. All tickers back to real-time.

title: Scheduled Fyers Gateway Maintenance
summary: Fyers broker backend scheduled routine database maintenance. No live market impact expected as it occurs over weekend window.

timeline.note: Vendor maintenance notification received and registered.
